sourceRepository.name: affiliate-content-operations
sourceRepository.workingTreeState: Included the current uncommitted Tistory implementation from the listed source paths.

adaptations: Rewired Tistory credential-store imports to the local scripts directory so the package does not depend on the monorepo.
Updated statistics and explicit-request CLIs to use the local DPAPI provider by default while retaining the runtime-only cookie compatibility override.
Merged the existing package scripts with login, session handoff, and media upload commands; pinned jsdom 26.1.0 and tough-cookie 5.1.2.

Added a generic HTML5 renderVideo helper and videoScript. The helper requires a verified upload receipt with matching source/CDN SHA-256 and byte counts, escapes captions, and resolves the rendered CDN link at runtime without embedding its signed URL.
excluded: Cookie values, access or refresh tokens, account selectors, and owner/blog identity values
DPAPI credential files, browser profiles, session bundles, private keys, and raw HAR/network captures
Signed media URLs, task-specific publication payloads, local source assets, and runtime journals
